Sandbox_BFMDBCompat_MinBreastSize_toolti: Breast size of the female player when NOT lactating. 0 = vanilla-like (default), 1 = fully feminine (the 'more feminine' shape).
Sandbox_BFMDBCompat_MaxLactationBreastSi: Breast size when lactation is full. 1.0 = the standard maximum (default). Higher values go bigger than that, up to 3.0. Size scales between the minimum and this value as lactation rises.
